parsed.why: Repealed criminalisation, no trans-specific offence or targeting; occasional police modesty charges and common individual harassment, but no documented state hostility, border friction, or trans violence — moderate-elevated, not low.

2024 law criminalises gender expression and transition itself (1–3 years), 10–15 years for same-sex relations, documented militia killings with state impunity — state-tolerated organised targeting of the outed traveller at near-extreme severity.

Self-ID, hate-speech and anti-discrimination law covering trans people, prosecuted mass shooter, declining threat assessment; rising reported hate crime and low police clearance temper but do not approach hostility tiers.

Constitutional and statutory trans protections and marker-change law, but weak enforcement — anti-LGBT murders uninvestigated, widespread societal discrimination documented; no visitor-facing restriction, so elevated not high.

Enforced criminalisation (20 years plus whipping), all-state cross-dressing bans, ministerial licence to target trans people, venue raids including 208 arrests with leakages, killings with impunity — high frequency and state-directed targeting.
